posts.zh:
dsh-task-relay 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。跨会话任务队列与交接摘要：会话与子 agent 在共享的文件队列上投递、认领、完成、取消任务，并留下交接摘要供后续会话查看。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9a9e3a14cd2a62eb11ec.html
posts.en:
dsh-task-relay is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Cross-session task queue with handoff notes: sessions and subagents push, claim, complete and cancel tasks on a shared file-backed queue, and leave a handoff summary for whoever picks up next.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9a9e3a14cd2a62eb11ec.html
